channel.title: JoyPointer Updates
channel.description: Most recent JoyPointer releases with links to updates.

item.description:
## JoyPointer 1.0.0
First release.
- Use any macOS-compatible game controller as a mouse: left stick or D-pad moves the pointer, right stick scrolls. - A/B click, hold to drag, Y toggles the macOS on-screen keyboard. Buttons are remappable. - Automatic suspend while a registered game (including Steam titles) is frontmost. - Menu bar only, follows the system language (English, Korean, Japanese). - Lifetime license, activated on up to 3 Macs. Updates arrive through the built-in updater.
